title: Roadmap certify step structured output
$comment: R1.4 Step 9.11 (secondary). The certify step verifies that remediation fixes were applied correctly, producing a per-finding PASS/FAIL verdict and the aggregate certification report. Its Step.id is the literal 'certify', so the executor's registry-key resolver falls through to _tw_key = step.id and routes it to the PLAIN render_step_tool_write (NOT the id-check variant) -- certify carries NO roadmap_ids and therefore has NO MVR-3 / Contract #3 phantom-ID subset constraint. PRESERVE: the R1.3 CodeAssertion (assert_step_reachable) on CERTIFY_GATE is unaffected -- tool-write only changes HOW the markdown is produced, not the dispatch reachability of the step. The rendered markdown mirrors the shape produced by certify_prompts.generate_certification_report.
